description: We present nf-core/proteinfamilies, a scalable, open-source, and highly configurable Nextflow pipeline that constructs novel protein families or assigns new sequences to existing ones. Computational benchmarks demonstrate approximately linear scaling of resource requirements with dataset size, while biological evaluations show that the resulting families closely resemble manually curated protein families from established databases. The pipeline enables reproducible, large-scale exploration of protein sequence diversity.
name: nfcore proteinfamilies
